description: 天然災害區域排水設施受損情形 [stormwater and drainage and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集資料內容為係各年度天然災害區域排水設施受損情形依照各縣市、各災害種類及時間呈現，欄位內容包括民國年、災害種類、管理單位、災害開始時間、災害結束時間、縣市代碼、受災情形排水路、受災情形制水門、受災情形其他處、預估搶修總金額、預估搶修金額、預估修復金額等，提供區域排水設施因天然災害受損情形及相關經費等資訊供相關單位及民眾了解。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
